Seeking the Pearl enters walking

We can take our time training in the local environment,
so everything will be all okay.

In that case, I'll let her experience every possible situation.
As her Trainer, everything she could ever desire!

One day, Seeking the Pearl came barging into
the trainer's office with great momentum.

Temperature around 40°C! Bone-dry turf!
Of course, we'll need the exact opposite pattern as well!

The world races Seeking the Pearl is aiming for are uncharted territory.
No matter how much we prepare, it will never feel like enough.

Can we also randomize
the condition of each Umamusume?!

In the history of world racing, wild animals have even intruded onto the track!
That could easily happen in a race I run in, too!

Thanks to pulling an all-nighter, Seeking the Pearl
was able to challenge a wide variety of possibilities in virtual space.

Unforeseeable developments, unexpected troubles!
Only when we conquer them all can we truly say we are 'prepared'!

She seems to have put serious thought into how to spend her time overseas meaningfully.
However, domestic procedures also take time. In that case, let's use that—

An overseas expedition, long desired by Seeking the Pearl.
In terms of ability, it's far from impossible, but...

Gooood!! I'll leave that part to you!
Now then, next we run under an American scenario!

This long straight is the road leading to glory!
Umamusume of the world! Can you keep up with me?!
Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

Now, let us boot up the simulator!
Even in virtual space, I shall demonstrate my possibilities!

With this, we can recreate racecourses and formidable rivals from around the world!
Very good!!

Heheh, not bad for just getting started yesterday.
Come on, let's run to our hearts' content!!

First, let's set our sights on France!
Bonjour, Calvados!

Springy turf... Heheh, it feels great under my feet!
I'm going to accelerate to top speed just like this!

Applying to Tracen Academy, getting approval from the URA, race registration abroad,
securing lodging... All these procedures will take time.

No!! That's not enough to call it perfect!
Next, bring on some bison and deer to run alongside me!!

I've already factored that in♪ We'll use the waiting period
to acclimate to France's turf and atmosphere.
I'll run through every "future" we can possibly imagine!!
Heheh, that's the spirit!

The VR Umalator is a racing simulator.
It can recreate various racecourses, weather conditions, and more.

But Seeking the Pearl is waiting in the gymnasium.
...I have to... go to the gym... n-now...
Yes! Tough Umamusume are waiting across the ocean!

Is Trainer running late?
...Oh, the data input is already finished!
—The VR Umalator! So that's what we're using!

Come on, pack your bags!
We're taking on world-class races!

I inputted the data and booted up the program.
It recreated a French race, with top Umamusume contenders from across the globe!

Leaving a swarm of fierce rivals in the dust, Seeking the Pearl
blazed across the finish line in first place...!

—I want to answer Seeking the Pearl's passion.
Before I knew it, I had spent the entire night glued to my computer... and morning had arrived.
